NAME: SPI master verification plan
details: Block 13: garuda_spim_top, the vendored PULP apb_spi_master behind the APB shim, single-bit mode 0, two chip selects. Source: GARUDA-SPIM-SPEC-001, decisions D-16, D-17, D-21. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. Vendored code is covered as far as single-bit mode 0 reaches; quad mode and the unused chip selects are waived with the reason. Mirafra's UVM environment (51 tests, write path only) is an additional environment, not the closing one.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 1, 0x4000_1000. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 STATUS write starts a transfer and selects the chip select
details: Offset 0x00. Bit 0 start read, bit 1 start write, bit 4 soft reset, bit 8 selects the flash, bit 9 the IMU, bits 11:10 must be 0. Spec 6.1, [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim (APB agent, SPI slave agent, scoreboard). Today: tb_spim [R-1], [R-3]

NAME: sb_xfer
details: The SPI slave agent's decoded transfer equals what the reference model expects for the write.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spim_start.x_dir_cs
details: Read and write starts on each chip select; both chip select bits set; neither set.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F02 STATUS read shows engine idle and both FIFO levels
details: Bit 0 idle, bits 20:16 receive occupancy, bits 28:24 transmit occupancy. Idle is also true between the start write and the engine acting on it. Spec [N-6.1a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spim reads occupancy

NAME: sb_status
details: Every STATUS read compared with the model's FIFO levels.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spim_status.cp_idle_race
details: STATUS read 0, 1 and 2 pclk after a start write.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F03 CLKDIV SPICMD SPIADR SPILEN and SPIDUM
details: Offsets 0x04 to 0x14, read-write, reset 0. SPILEN bits 5:0 command bits, 13:8 address bits, 31:16 data bits. SPIDUM bits 15:0 dummy cycles before read, 31:16 before write.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_spim read-back of some

NAME: ral_access config
details: Reset value and read-back of each field; no aliasing between the five.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F04 TXFIFO and RXFIFO
details: Offset 0x18 write-only, 0x20 read-only, 32 bits, ten entries each. A read of RXFIFO removes a word. A read when empty and a write when full are not described; to be read from the RTL and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spim reads words

NAME: sb_fifo
details: Model compare of every word and of both occupancy counts.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spim_fifo.x_fifo_level
details: Each FIFO empty, 1, 9, 10; a read when empty; a write when full.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F05 INTCFG and INTSTA from the vendored block
details: Offsets 0x24 and 0x28. FIFO threshold configuration and event status.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: no check.

NAME: ral_access INTCFG INTSTA
details: Reset value, read-back of INTCFG, INTSTA read-only.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F06 IRQSTAT IRQEN DMACTL and ID in the shim
details: Offsets 0xFE0 to 0xFEC. IRQSTAT bit 0 transfer complete, 1 receive threshold, 2 transmit threshold. DMACTL bit 0 requests on receive data, bit 1 on transmit space. ID reads 0x6A5D, block 13 and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_spim reads ID, uses IRQSTAT bit 0

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Access policy of the four shim registers.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F07 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and accesses never wait
details: 0x1C, 0x2C to 0xFDC, 0xFF0 and above, unaligned offsets. PREADY is high in every cycle, including while the wrapper polls STATUS. Requirement R-5.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spim [R-5]

NAME: sb_pslverr
details: PSLVERR compared with the model's address map.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_poll_never_blocks
details: A bus access is never delayed or answered with the wrapper's poll data.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_spim_apb.x_unmapped_rw
details: Each unmapped range read and written; an access in each phase of the poll.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F08 Reset values
details: All registers 0, both chip selects high, SCLK low. Requirement R-8.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_spim [R-8]

NAME: ral_reset
details: Register model reset test.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: B Transfers
details: Spec 6.3, 7.1, 7.2. Checked by an SPI slave agent on the pins.

NAME: F09 Command address dummy and data phases
details: Each with its programmed length, in that order, most significant bit first from bit 31. Requirement R-1, spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spim flash read - command 0x03, 24-bit address, 32-bit data

NAME: sb_xfer
details: Bit count and value of each phase compared with the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spim_len.x_cmd_addr_dummy_data
details: Command 0, 8, 32 bits; address 0, 24, 32; dummy 0, 1, 8; data 0, 1, 8, 31, 32, 33, 320 bits; reads and writes.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F10 The chip select is held for the whole transfer
details: Asserted before the first clock and released after the last, with no gap between phases. Requirement R-2, spec [N-6.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spim [R-3] CS checks

NAME: a_cs_held
details: The selected chip select is low from the first SCLK edge to the last of a transfer.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F11 The two chip selects are independent and exclusive
details: Only the selected one goes low. Requirement R-3.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spim [R-3]

NAME: a_cs_excl
details: The two chip selects are never low together unless both bits were written.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F12 Mode 0
details: SCLK idles low, MOSI changes on the falling edge, MISO is sampled on the rising edge. Spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spim against the flash model

NAME: sb_mode0
details: The slave agent checks MOSI stable around every rising edge and SCLK low whenever chip select is high.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_cs_idle
details: SCLK is 0 whenever both chip selects are high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F13 SCLK rate
details: pclk divided by 2 x (CLKDIV + 1); at most 20 MHz at the boot value CLKDIV 3. Requirement R-4, spec [N-6.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spim measures the period at CLKDIV 3

NAME: sb_sclk_period
details: The slave agent measures every SCLK period.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spim_rate.cp_clkdiv
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F14 MISO sampling at small CLKDIV
details: MISO passes through a two-flop synchroniser. At CLKDIV 0 to 2 the delay may exceed half an SCLK period; the smallest CLKDIV at which reads are correct has to be measured and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_spim_rate.x_clkdiv_read
details: A read transfer at each CLKDIV from 0 to 4 with data checked.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_xfer
details: Read data compared with what the slave agent drove.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F15 Receive word order
details: RXFIFO returns the four bytes in arrival order, first byte in bits 31:24. Spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spim; the flash boot test

NAME: sb_xfer
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F16 A read longer than the FIFO
details: More than ten words in one transfer. What the engine does when the receive FIFO is full - stop the clock or lose data - has to be read from the RTL and written down. Spec [N-7.3a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_spim_fifo.cp_rx_full_in_transfer
details: Receive FIFO full during a transfer, drained late, drained in time.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F17 Soft reset
details: STATUS bit 4 during a transfer returns the engine to idle with chip select high and both FIFOs empty.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_spim_start.cp_soft_reset_phase
details: Soft reset in each phase and while idle.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: a_cs_idle
details: Covered by F12.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F18 Back-to-back transfers and a start while busy
details: A second start written before the first transfer ends is not described; to be read from the RTL and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_spim_start.cp_start_while_busy
details: Start written while idle bit is 0.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F19 The unused state of the vendored controller
details: State MODE is never entered and has no exit; in it chip select is low with the clock running. Open defect SPIM-2.
implementation_note: Method: formal (unreachability) + static. Today: HAL TERMST and UNRCHS, waived

NAME: a_no_mode_state
details: The controller state is never MODE.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: C Pins
details: Requirement R-8, spec [N-7.5], [N-7.6].

details: Requirement R-8.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spim [R-8]

details: Both chip selects are 1 and SCLK is 0 while preset_n is low and until the first start.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

details: The wrapper never enables quad mode, MOSI is the only driven data line, and MISO is connected to the lane the vendored receiver shifts in. Spec [N-7.5], [N-7.6].
implementation_note: Method: sim + static. Today: tb_spim reads correct data; the flash boot test

implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: a_irq_held
details: irq_o equals the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: An event in the cycle of its own clear leaves the bit set.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_master/garuda_spim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_spim_irq.x_src_en
